Author: Deuflhard
Description: ETK 854 ActiveHybrid 30e (I4) - entry model and original platform of the range: a P2 plug-in hybrid modeled on current premium plug-in hybrids, built around an 8HP-type transmission. 2.0 L inline-four turbo gasoline engine (188 kW / 255 PS, 362 Nm) + K0 disconnect clutch + 83 kW / 265 Nm P2 e-machine ahead of the torque converter, 8-speed automatic, rear-wheel drive via the stock transfer case, limited-slip rear differential with a 3.15 final drive. 13.5 kWh battery. System output 271 kW (368 PS) / 630 Nm. Driving Experience COMFORT / ECO PRO / SPORT and EV modes AUTO EV / MAX EV / BATTERY CONTROL, sailing, recuperation and all-electric pull-away. DSC/DTC and cooling package as on the six-cylinder models; delivered without a factory top-speed limiter.
